# kraken-cli

Agent-first CLI for trading crypto, stocks, forex, and derivatives on Kraken with structured JSON output. One install puts `kraken`, `kraken-mcp` (the MCP server) and `kraken-shell` on your PATH.

## Start Here

- [CONTEXT.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krakenfx/kraken-cli/main/CONTEXT.md): Runtime context for tool-using agents
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krakenfx/kraken-cli/main/AGENTS.md): Full integration guide for agent builders
- [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krakenfx/kraken-cli/main/CLAUDE.md): Anthropic-specific guidance
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krakenfx/kraken-cli/main/README.md): Install, commands and troubleshooting

## Machine Contracts

- [agents/tool-catalog.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krakenfx/kraken-cli/main/agents/tool-catalog.json): Canonical command catalog (188 commands, with generated argument schemas, `dangerous` flags and a `reach` field that says which are MCP tools)
- [agents/error-catalog.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krakenfx/kraken-cli/main/agents/error-catalog.json): Error categories and retry guidance

## Workflow Skills

- [skills/INDEX.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krakenfx/kraken-cli/main/skills/INDEX.md): Goal-oriented SKILL.md packages for execution, market intel, paper testing, and risk operations

## Docs Site

- [kraken-cli](https://docs.kraken.com/home/cli): Install and command overview
- [MCP server](https://docs.kraken.com/home/mcp): Client setup and services

## Notes

- `tool-catalog.json` is the single source of truth for command discovery.
- `kraken-mcp -s market,paper,feedback` starts the built-in MCP server over stdio with no live-trading tools. Add `trade` only with a least-privilege API key.
- Install: `curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://github.com/krakenfx/kraken-cli/releases/latest/download/kraken-cli-installer.sh | sh`
